question: Did the checkout redesign reduce abandoned carts?
takeaway: Abandonment fell from 71% to 58% in the four weeks after the redesign shipped.
title: Cart abandonment fell 13 points after the checkout redesign
subtitle: Share of carts abandoned, weekly, all regions, weeks 20 to 36

value_scale.reason_not_zero: The rate stays between 55% and 75%, and the change within that range is the message; the axis shows 40 to 80 with labelled ticks.

annotations: Vertical rule at week 28, labelled 'Redesign shipped'

text_alternative.short: Line chart: weekly cart abandonment drops from about 71% to 58% after the redesign in week 28.
text_alternative.long: The vertical axis runs from 40% to 80%. From week 20 to week 27 the rate holds between 70% and 72%. The redesign ships in week 28. The rate falls each week until week 32 and then holds near 58% through week 36.
